description: This source file defines the PersistableOrder class, a Java class representing an order entity with associated customer and product details. It extends OrderEntity and implements Serializable, providing getter and setter methods for its fields.

classes.name: PersistableOrder
classes.description: A Java class representing a persistable order, including customer info and list of order products.

methods.name: setOrderProductItems
methods.description: Sets the list of order product items associated with this order.

methods.name: getOrderProductItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of order product items associated with this order.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: isShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Checks if the order is set to ship to the billing address.

methods.name: setShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Sets whether the order should ship to the billing address.
